situation: Family seal maker that behaves like a group: a pricing committee approves changes above 2 %. Standard items are never discounted; only multi-year volume agreements move price. It is allocating standard mechanical seals by last year's call-offs (6,840 pc of 340011 in FY2026, while the forecast is +11.4 %). It holds 60 % of the 32 mm seal (Ravensteiner, the other source, is also capacity-tight) and 50 % of the lip seal, where it is 10.6 % dearer than Hermannsdorfer. The P15 kit could take that lip-seal volume away.
